explanation: The statement involves purely library-local notions: the scheme equivalence relation `CategoryTheory.EquivalenceRelation p₁ p₂` (no occurrence in Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry), `Scheme.finrank`, `finrankOpen`, `finrankRangeFintype`, and the equalizer of `p₁.appTop.hom.toIntAlgHom` / `p₂.appTop.hom.toIntAlgHom`. Searches for `finrankOpen`, `finrankRangeFintype`, `exists_completeOrthogonalIdempotents` and `EquivalenceRelation` in the AlgebraicGeometry part of Mathlib return nothing. Mathlib's `CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents` (Mathlib/RingTheory/Idempotents.lean) only provides generic ring-theoretic lemmas (idem/ortho/complete, `map`, `of_ker_isNilpotent`, `single`, `equiv`, ...), none of which produces this scheme-theoretic family of idempotents cutting out the finrank strata; the proof here goes through the library's own `exists_completeOrthogonalIdempotents_finrankOpen` and Stacks 03BI material. No Mathlib declaration states or immediately yields this result.
